question: Which law states that the period of a planet's orbit around the Sun increases exponentially with the radius of its orbit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kepler's third law**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Kepler's third law of planetary motion**, also known as the Law of Harmonies, establishes a relationship between the orbital period of a planet and the radius of its orbit.
 
• It states that the square of the orbital period (T²) of a planet is directly proportional to the cube of the semi-major axis (r³) of its orbit.
 
• The mathematical expression of this law is: T² ∝ r³.
